review_scope: Fixed 12-question development pilot; Codex source/reference review, not independent human validation.

grades.reviewer_reason: Correctly states that a failed raw-file download returns an empty string.
Correct rate-limit and token guidance, but omits PermissionError handling and adds unsupported retry advice.
Correctly explains AST parsing and function docstring extraction.
Correct values, but omits the requested word units.
Incorrectly places asyncio.to_thread in the synchronous downloader; the async wrapper _fetch_one performs the offload.
Correct 5000-character limit, but omits that the first characters are retained.
Correct cap/sorting idea, but does not state the MAX_SELECTED_FILES slice explicitly and invents rank_chunks.
Incorrectly names Agent_State instead of the add_messages reducer.
Correct reports directory, but adds an unsupported claim that it is under writer.py.
Correctly identifies exit and quit, but omits case-insensitive lowercasing.
